name_input: SIMPOLO INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED; SIMPOLO INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED; SIMPOLO INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/simpolo-international-private-limited) reports "Total Shipments 448 Records detected", "Trading Partners 20", "Ports 34", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-19". Exact record line quoted: "2026-02-19 | SIMPOLO INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED TO THE ORDER | GLAZED VITRIFIED TILES (OTHER DETAILS AS PER INVOICE AND PACKING LIST)- MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India | Puerto Quetzal, Guatemala | 69072100 | BOL 9815681". Additional dated export rows actually seen on the page: 2026-02-18 GLAZED VITRIFIED TILES, Mundra Sea -> Port Everglades, UNITED STATES, HS 69072100, BOL 9780945; 2026-02-13 GLAZED PORCELAIN TILES, Mundra Sea -> Port of Spain, TRINIDAD TOBAGO, HS 69072100, BOL 9652707. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 448 total shipments; 5 individual shipment rows were rendered in the free view (3 of them outbound exports, 2 inbound imports of machinery from XINCHENG INTERNATIONAL (HONG KONG) and MECTILES ITALIA S.R.L.). Declared HS 690721 matches the observed export HS 69072100 (glazed vitrified/porcelain tiles) - no HS correction needed.
domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden; DuckDuckGo search backend was down ("searx: Connection refused") for all queries, so no GeM/CPPP tender, GST turnover band or annual-report split could be located. GST turnover: null (not public in retrieved sources). Note: the ImportKey page does show the company as a buyer/importer of ceramic-plant machinery ("CONVEYORS FOR SIMPOLO MEGA POLISHING LINE-8", ICD MORBI INWDH6, 2026-02-16, HS 84283300, BOL 7548905), which evidences an operating Morbi (Gujarat) production facility, but that is an import record, not a domestic sale record, so it is not counted as domestic supply evidence.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number - not merely website claims. Company is an active Morbi ceramic-tile exporter (Guatemala, USA, Trinidad & Tobago lanes observed). Declared HS 690721 is consistent with observed 69072100. Domestic supply status left as unknown rather than declared_only because no GST/tender/contract source was reachable within the tool budget - this is a data-access gap, not a negative finding. State: the shipment records point to Morbi, Gujarat (ICD MORBI, Mundra Sea) rather than the claimed Andhra Pradesh; worth flagging for address verification, but not a rejection ground. No rejection criteria met (entity clearly exists and is trading).
